title: चतुस्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 34 · Vyasa's answer on the cause of the war

summary.en: Vyasa tells Yudhishthira that the war was ordained by time and that the Pandavas, forced to fight, are free of fault. He says that in the old wars of the gods and asuras the elder and younger brothers also fought, and bids him rule by dharma.
summary.kn: ಯುದ್ಧ ಕಾಲದ ವಿಧಿ, ಒತ್ತಾಯದಿಂದ ಹೋರಾಡಿದ ಪಾಂಡವರು ದೋಷಮುಕ್ತರೆಂದು ವ್ಯಾಸರು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಹಿಂದಿನ ದೇವಾಸುರ ಯುದ್ಧಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿರಿಯ, ಕಿರಿಯ ಸಹೋದರರೂ ಹೋರಾಡಿದರೆಂದು ಹೇಳಿ ಧರ್ಮದಿಂದ ಆಳಲು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: व्यास युधिष्ठिर से कहते हैं कि युद्ध काल द्वारा विधान था और विवश होकर लड़ने वाले पाण्डव निर्दोष हैं। वे बताते हैं कि प्राचीन देवासुर युद्धों में बड़े-छोटे भाई भी लड़े थे, और धर्म से राज करने को कहते हैं।
summary.te: యుద్ధం కాలం నిర్ణయించిందని, బలవంతంగా పోరాడిన పాండవులు నిర్దోషులని వ్యాసుడు యుధిష్ఠిరునికి చెబుతాడు. పూర్వ దేవాసుర యుద్ధాల్లో అన్నదమ్ములూ పోరాడారని చెప్పి ధర్మంతో పాలించమంటాడు.
summary.ta: போர் காலத்தின் விதி, வலுக்கட்டாயமாகப் போரிட்ட பாண்டவர் குற்றமற்றவர் என்று வியாசர் யுதிஷ்டிரரிடம் கூறுகிறார். பழைய தேவாசுரப் போர்களிலும் மூத்தவரும் இளையவரும் போரிட்டனர் என்று கூறி தர்மப்படி ஆளும்படி சொல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: യുദ്ധം കാലം നിശ്ചയിച്ചതാണെന്നും, യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യേണ്ടിവന്ന പാണ്ഡവർ കുറ്റമില്ലാത്തവരാണെന്നും വ്യാസൻ യുധിഷ്ഠിരനോട് പറയുന്നു. ദേവന്മാരും അസുരന്മാരും തമ്മിലുള്ള പഴയ യുദ്ധങ്ങളിലും മൂത്തവരും ഇളയവരും സഹോദരന്മാരായി പോരാടിയിരുന്നുവെന്നും, ധർമ്മപ്രകാരം ഭരിക്കാൻ അദ്ദേഹം യുധിഷ്ഠിരനോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.34; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरस्य तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा द्वैपायनस्तदा ।
समीक्ष्य निपुणं बुद्ध्या ऋषिः प्रोवाच पाण्डवम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Yudhishthira's words, Dvaipayana then reflected carefully with his mind, and the sage said to the Pandava:

verses.text:
मा विषादं कृथा राजन्क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मर ।
स्वधर्मेण हता ह्येते क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: King, do not despair; remember the dharma of a kshatriya. These kshatriyas, bull among kshatriyas, were killed in their own dharma.

verses.text:
काङ्क्षमाणाः श्रियं कृत्स्नां पृथिव्यां च महद्यशः ।
कृतान्तविधिसंयुक्ताः कालेन निधनं गताः ॥

meaning.en: Desiring all wealth and great fame on earth, bound by the ordinance of fate, they met their end through time.

verses.text:
न त्वं हन्ता न भीमोऽपि नार्जुनो न यमावपि ।
कालः पर्यायधर्मेण प्राणानादत्त देहिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: You are not the killer, nor Bhima, nor Arjuna, nor the twins; Time, by the rule of turns, takes away the lives of embodied beings.

verses.text:
न यस्य मातापितरौ नानुग्राह्योऽस्ति कश्चन ।
कर्मसाक्षी प्रजानां यस्तेन कालेन संहृताः ॥

meaning.en: He has no mother or father, and none to favor; he is the witness of the deeds of creatures, and by that Time they were all gathered in.

verses.text:
हेतुमात्रमिदं तस्य कालस्य पुरुषर्षभ ।
यद्धन्ति भूतैर्भूतानि तदस्मै रूपमैश्वरम् ॥

meaning.en: This is only the cause for Time, bull among men: that beings slay beings; that is his lordly form.

verses.text:
कर्ममूर्त्यात्मकं विद्धि साक्षिणं शुभपापयोः ।
सुखदुःखगुणोदर्कं कालं कालफलप्रदम् ॥

meaning.en: Know Time, whose form is action, the witness of good and bad, whose results are pleasure and pain, and who gives the fruit of time.

verses.text:
तेषामपि महाबाहो कर्माणि परिचिन्तय ।
विनाशहेतुकारित्वे यैस्ते कालवशं गताः ॥

meaning.en: Mighty-armed one, think also on the deeds of those men, by which they brought about their own destruction and came under the power of Time.

verses.text:
आत्मनश्च विजानीहि नियमव्रतशीलताम् ।
यदा त्वमीदृशं कर्म विधिनाक्रम्य कारितः ॥

meaning.en: And understand your own restraint, vows and good conduct, by which, though you were compelled by fate to do this deed.

verses.text:
त्वष्ट्रेव विहितं यन्त्रं यथा स्थापयितुर्वशे ।
कर्मणा कालयुक्तेन तथेदं भ्राम्यते जगत् ॥

meaning.en: As a machine made by a craftsman stays in the control of its operator, so this world is turned by action joined to Time.

verses.text:
पुरुषस्य हि दृष्ट्वेमामुत्पत्तिमनिमित्ततः ।
यदृच्छया विनाशं च शोकहर्षावनर्थकौ ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that a man's birth and his death come without cause, by chance, grief and joy are pointless.

verses.text:
व्यलीकं चापि यत्त्वत्र चित्तवैतंसिकं तव ।
तदर्थमिष्यते राजन्प्रायश्चित्तं तदाचर ॥

meaning.en: Yet if you still feel a fault in your mind about this, then atonement is prescribed for it; perform it.

verses.text:
इदं च श्रूयते पार्थ युद्धे देवासुरे पुरा ।
असुरा भ्रातरो ज्येष्ठा देवाश्चापि यवीयसः ॥

meaning.en: Partha, it is heard that in the ancient war of gods and asuras, the asuras were the elder brothers and the gods the younger.

verses.text:
तेषामपि श्रीनिमित्तं महानासीत्समुच्छ्रयः ।
युद्धं वर्षसहस्राणि द्वात्रिंशदभवत्किल ॥

meaning.en: A great struggle arose between them too over prosperity; the war is said to have lasted thirty-two thousand years.

verses.text:
एकार्णवां महीं कृत्वा रुधिरेण परिप्लुताम् ।
जघ्नुर्दैत्यांस्तदा देवास्त्रिदिवं चैव लेभिरे ॥

meaning.en: Making the earth a single ocean soaked in blood, the gods killed the Daityas and won heaven.

verses.text:
तथैव पृथिवीं लब्ध्वा ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः ।
संश्रिता दानवानां वै साह्यार्थे दर्पमोहिताः ॥

meaning.en: In the same way, brahmins who had mastered the Veda, intoxicated with pride, took refuge with the Danavas to help them.

verses.text:
शालावृका इति ख्यातास्त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत ।
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि ते चापि विबुधैर्हताः ॥

meaning.en: They were known in the three worlds as the Shalavrikas, Bharata, eighty-eight thousand of them, and they too were killed by the gods.

verses.text:
धर्मव्युच्छित्तिमिच्छन्तो येऽधर्मस्य प्रवर्तकाः ।
हन्तव्यास्ते दुरात्मानो देवैर्दैत्या इवोल्बणाः ॥

meaning.en: Those who seek the ruin of dharma and promote adharma are evil-souled and must be killed, like the fierce Daityas by the gods.

verses.text:
एकं हत्वा यदि कुले शिष्टानां स्यादनामयम् ।
कुलं हत्वाथ राष्ट्रं वा न तद्वृत्तोपघातकम् ॥

meaning.en: If by killing one person the good in a family are made safe, or by destroying a family or a realm, that does not destroy good conduct.

verses.text:
अधर्मरूपो धर्मो हि कश्चिदस्ति नराधिप ।
धर्मश्चाधर्मरूपोऽस्ति तच्च ज्ञेयं विपश्चिता ॥

meaning.en: Lord of men, there is some dharma that has the form of adharma, and some adharma that has the form of dharma; the wise must know this.

verses.text:
तस्मात्संस्तम्भयात्मानं श्रुतवानसि पाण्डव ।
देवैः पूर्वगतं मार्गमनुयातोऽसि भारत ॥

meaning.en: So steady yourself, Pandava; you have learned, and you have followed the path that the gods took before.

verses.text:
न हीदृशा गमिष्यन्ति नरकं पाण्डवर्षभ ।
भ्रातॄनाश्वासयैतांस्त्वं सुहृदश्च परंतप ॥

meaning.en: Such men as you will not go to hell, best of the Pandavas; comfort these brothers of yours and your friends, scorcher of foes.

verses.text:
यो हि पापसमारम्भे कार्ये तद्भावभावितः ।
कुर्वन्नपि तथैव स्यात्कृत्वा च निरपत्रपः ॥

meaning.en: A man who, in setting about an evil act, is steeped in that intent, does the same act and then feels no shame.

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तत्कलुषं सर्वं समाप्तमिति शब्दितम् ।
प्रायश्चित्तं न तस्यास्ति ह्रासो वा पापकर्मणः ॥

meaning.en: In him all that stain is called complete; there is no atonement for him, nor any diminishing of his sinful act.

verses.text:
त्वं तु शुक्लाभिजातीयः परदोषेण कारितः ।
अनिच्छमानः कर्मेदं कृत्वा च परितप्यसे ॥

meaning.en: But you are of pure birth, and were driven by another's fault; having done this deed unwillingly, you are tormented.

verses.text:
अश्वमेधो महायज्ञः प्रायश्चित्तमुदाहृतम् ।
तमाहर महाराज विपाप्मैवं भविष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: The great sacrifice of the horse is declared the atonement; perform it, great king, and you will be freed from sin.

verses.text:
मरुद्भिः सह जित्वारीन्मघवान्पाकशासनः ।
एकैकं क्रतुमाहृत्य शतकृत्वः शतक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: Mighty Indra, punisher of Paka, conquered his enemies with the Maruts and performed a hundred sacrifices, one after another.

verses.text:
पूतपाप्मा जितस्वर्गो लोकान्प्राप्य सुखोदयान् ।
मरुद्गणवृतः शक्रः शुशुभे भासयन्दिशः ॥

meaning.en: His sin cleansed, having conquered heaven and gained worlds of rising happiness, Shakra shone surrounded by the host of Maruts, lighting the directions.

verses.text:
स्वर्गलोके महीयन्तमप्सरोभिः शचीपतिम् ।
ऋषयः पर्युपासन्ते देवाश्च विबुधेश्वरम् ॥

meaning.en: The sages and gods attend upon the lord of the gods, husband of Shachi, as he is honored in heaven by apsarases.

verses.text:
सोऽयं त्वमिह संक्रान्तो विक्रमेण वसुंधराम् ।
निर्जिताश्च महीपाला विक्रमेण त्वयानघ ॥

meaning.en: You, here, have taken the earth by valor, and the kings were defeated by your valor, blameless one.

verses.text:
तेषां पुराणि राष्ट्राणि गत्वा राजन्सुहृद्वृतः ।
भ्रातॄन्पुत्रांश्च पौत्रांश्च स्वे स्वे राज्येऽभिषेचय ॥

meaning.en: Go, king, with your friends around you, to their cities and realms, and anoint their brothers, sons and grandsons each in their own kingdom.

verses.text:
बालानपि च गर्भस्थान्सान्त्वानि समुदाचरन् ।
रञ्जयन्प्रकृतीः सर्वाः परिपाहि वसुंधराम् ॥

meaning.en: Treating even the children and those in the womb with kindness, and pleasing all the subjects, protect the earth.

verses.text:
कुमारो नास्ति येषां च कन्यास्तत्राभिषेचय ।
कामाशयो हि स्त्रीवर्गः शोकमेवं प्रहास्यति ॥

meaning.en: Where they have no son, anoint the daughters there, for womankind is moved by desire, and so they will cast off their grief.

verses.text:
एवमाश्वासनं कृत्वा सर्वराष्ट्रेषु भारत ।
यजस्व वाजिमेधेन यथेन्द्रो विजयी पुरा ॥

meaning.en: Having brought such comfort in all the kingdoms, Bharata, sacrifice with the horse sacrifice as Indra did in the past when victorious.

verses.text:
अशोच्यास्ते महात्मानः क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभ ।
स्वकर्मभिर्गता नाशं कृतान्तबलमोहिताः ॥

meaning.en: Those great-souled kshatriyas are not to be mourned, bull among kshatriyas; they went to destruction by their own deeds, deluded by the power of fate.

verses.text:
अवाप्तः क्षत्रधर्मस्ते राज्यं प्राप्तमकल्मषम् ।
चरस्व धर्मं कौन्तेय श्रेयान्यः प्रेत्य भाविकः ॥

meaning.en: You have attained the kshatriya's dharma and gained a kingdom free of stain; follow dharma, son of Kunti, which is best for the future after death.
